package parents

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	xhandler "github.com/viant/xdatly/handler"
)

var (
	_ xhandler.OnRelationer = (*ParentRow)(nil)
	_ xhandler.OnRelationer = (*SignalRow)(nil)
)

func (r *ParentRow) OnFetch(context.Context) error {
	if r.Id == 1 {
		r.Signals = []*SignalRow{
			{ParentId: r.Id, FeatureType: "a", FeatureValue: "shared"},
			{ParentId: r.Id, FeatureType: "b", FeatureValue: "shared"},
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *SignalRow) OnRelation(context.Context) {
	if r.Perf == nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("missing lookup for %s/%s", r.FeatureType, r.FeatureValue))
	}
	r.Score = r.Perf.Score
	r.Perf = nil
}

func (r *ParentRow) OnRelation(context.Context) {
	values := make([]string, 0, len(r.Signals))
	for _, signal := range r.Signals {
		values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s=%d", signal.FeatureType, signal.FeatureValue, signal.Score))
	}
	r.Summary = strings.Join(values, ",")
	r.Signals = nil
}
